name: CompanyEnrich
description: Live B2B company and people data for AI agents. Enrich a company by domain, name, or social profile, search companies and people, find similar companies, and look up a person from an email address.
author: CompanyEnrich

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Enriches a company by domain. Costs 1 credit per call, plus 5 additional credits when includeWorkforce is true.

domain.description: The domain name of the company to enrich, for example example.com.

includeWorkforce.description: When true, requests expanded workforce insights. Costs 5 additional credits per company.

tools.name: get_company_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves a company by CompanyEnrich company ID. Costs 1 credit per call, plus 5 additional credits when includeWorkforce is true.

includeWorkforce.description: When true, requests expanded workforce insights. Costs 5 additional credits per company.

tools.name: enrich_company_by_properties
tools.description: Enriches a company by known properties such as name or social profile URL. Costs 1 credit per call, plus 5 additional credits when includeWorkforce is true.

includeWorkforce.description: When true, requests expanded workforce insights. Costs 5 additional credits per company.

tools.name: get_company_workforce
tools.description: Returns workforce insights for a single company by CompanyEnrich company ID or domain. Costs 5 credits per successful call.

id.description: CompanyEnrich company ID. Provide either id or domain.

domain.description: Company domain. Provide either id or domain.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Searches companies with page-based pagination. semanticQuery is optional; use it for natural-language profile search, and use query for name/domain focused searches. Costs 1 credit per company returned, with a 1-credit minimum.

semanticQuery.description: Natural-language query describing the kinds of companies to find.

semanticWeight.description: Semantic weight from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7 in the API.

query.description: Search query applied to company name and domain.

exclude.description: Exclude companies matching any of these filters.

categoryOperator.description: Operator for category filters. Defaults to And in the API.

keywordsOperator.description: Operator for keyword filters. Defaults to And in the API.

technologiesOperator.description: Operator for technology filters. Defaults to And in the API.

period.description: Period to measure workforce growth over.

department.description: Department to measure workforce growth for. Use overall for total workforce.

minPercent.description: Minimum workforce growth percentage, inclusive. Use negative values for declines.

maxPercent.description: Maximum workforce growth percentage, inclusive. Use negative values for declines.

department.description: Department to filter by. Use overall for total workforce.

includeWorkforce.description: When true, requests expanded workforce insights. Costs 5 additional credits per company.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: find_similar_companies
tools.description: Finds companies similar to one or more seed domains, with optional filters. Costs 5 credits per company returned, with a 5-credit minimum.

domains.description: Company domain names to find similar companies for. Up to 10 domains.

similarityWeight.description: Similarity weight from -1 to 1. Higher favors similarity, lower favors established companies.

minScore.description: Minimum similarity score required for returned companies.

query.description: Search query applied to company name and domain.

exclude.description: Exclude companies matching any of these filters.

categoryOperator.description: Operator for category filters. Defaults to And in the API.

keywordsOperator.description: Operator for keyword filters. Defaults to And in the API.

technologiesOperator.description: Operator for technology filters. Defaults to And in the API.

period.description: Period to measure workforce growth over.

department.description: Department to measure workforce growth for. Use overall for total workforce.

minPercent.description: Minimum workforce growth percentage, inclusive. Use negative values for declines.

maxPercent.description: Maximum workforce growth percentage, inclusive. Use negative values for declines.

department.description: Department to filter by. Use overall for total workforce.

includeWorkforce.description: When true, requests expanded workforce insights. Costs 5 additional credits per company.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_person_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves a person by CompanyEnrich person ID. Costs 2 credits per call.

tools.name: lookup_person_by_email
tools.description: Looks up a person by email address. The API resolves the company from the email domain and matches the local part. Costs 5 credits per successful call.

email.description: The email address of the person to look up.

tools.name: enrich_person_email
tools.description: BETA: Resolves a work email address for a single person ID and optional company domain. Costs 10 credits per newly accessed found email.

domain.description: Optional company domain. If omitted, current experience domains are tried.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Searches people with page-based pagination. positionQuery accepts either one string or an array of strings. Costs 2 credits per person returned, with a 2-credit minimum.

atCurrentCompanyAfter.description: Only include people who joined their current company after this UTC datetime.

atCurrentCompanyBefore.description: Only include people who joined their current company before this UTC datetime.
